long_biography.plain_text:
Pierfrancesco Rodriguez Boccanelli has served as a director of Finstar, a Rome joint-stock company. The board also included Renata Boccanelli and Pierluigi Mauro Boccanelli, while Antonia Bianchi chaired it and Claudio Bottoni served as managing director. He uses Rodriguez Boccanelli as a compound surname across both corporate and sporting contexts.

Away from the boardroom, Rodriguez Boccanelli has maintained ties to cultural and sporting institutions. He supported the American Academy in Rome and entered national padel rankings. He also competed in clay-target shooting, taking third place in the third-category contest at a national Italian Helice event in 2024.
